answer: Epochal Cryptographic Lottery Gate: Agents register keys tied to hardware enclaves. Each epoch, the network harvests entropy from a public juniper seed and an unpredictable block hash to select active verification slots. An attacker attempting a Sybil swarm on an isolated island finds their unselected nodes dropped. To bypass this, the attacker must fund hundreds of physical enclaves with unique jade circuits, paying heavy per-node manufacturing and power costs while facing a high probability of total exclusion every epoch.
